investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-15T00:54–00:55Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, no required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions are unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning path — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every POST /api/agents call. Because all three sibling checks share the same upstream createAgent call path (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) and all returned the identical error message, the failure is localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not to individual check logic or eval runner code. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence; this is an eval-layer failure against the production-api environment.
